plan.title: 20-gene signature score vs survival, adjusted for case/control
plan.analytical_narrative: The cohort is 60 cases vs 60 controls (bulk RNA-seq, Salmon gene-level counts, 12000 genes x 121 samples incl. gene-symbol column; single batch) with a follow-up time and event indicator per sample and a pre-specified 20-gene signature (no weights/direction). The question is narrow and specific: does a per-sample score of that fixed signature associate with time-to-event once case/control status is accounted for. This is a prognostic-association test of an existing signature, not a discovery exercise, so no penalized/cross-validated gene selection is warranted -- the 20 genes are fixed inputs. The plan therefore: (1) runs standard sample-structure QC on the raw counts (vst-blind PCA, sample-distance heatmap) to catch outliers/mislabels before anything else; (2) filters low-count genes with edgeR::filterByExpr at the smallest-group-size threshold and produces a design-aware, variance-stabilized log2 matrix (DESeq2 median-of-ratios + vst) as scoring input, and confirms how many of the 20 signature genes survive filtering; (3) scores each sample with UCell's rank-based method (depth-independent, the default choice for a single gene list) and, as a descriptive check, compares the score between cases and controls with a t-test; (4) fits a Cox proportional-hazards model of Surv(time,event) on the standardized score plus the condition covariate, checks the proportional-hazards assumption via scaled Schoenfeld residuals, reports event/censoring counts and median follow-up, draws Kaplan-Meier curves for the picture only, and computes time-dependent AUC/C-index for discrimination; (5) synthesizes everything into a report with the full reproducibility record. No differential expression, enrichment, or new-signature-discovery step is included because the research question does not ask for them and none is needed to answer it.

steps.method: vst normalization for scoring input / TMM for edgeR path
UCell rank-based signature score per sample (20-gene signature)
Cox proportional hazards model: score (per-SD, continuous) + condition covariate
